lessons.claim: For POSIX inventory tools, validate every input boundary, including the manifest itself. A source-tree FIFO test does not cover a FIFO manifest. Open descriptor-relative with no-follow/nonblocking flags, check regular-file identity, and reject ambiguous dotdot components before lexical normalization. Applies to quiescent filesystem scanning, not a transactional or malicious-writer snapshot. Revisit if platform or accepted path semantics change.
